thread:
maria: Heads-up — we just got a high-priority ticket from Acme (acct: acme-corp). They report spikes of 429s on their Dedicated Gold pool since ~08:10 UTC. They say traffic was steady but latency and throttling skyrocketed.

maria: Paste of the snippet from their app logs: 
```
2026-03-10T08:09:59Z ERROR request failed status=429 route=/v1/generate tenant=acme-corp pool=dedicated-bronze token_cost=120
2026-03-10T08:10:01Z WARN reroute decided pool=dedicated-bronze reason=controlplane-match
```

dylan: do we have any deploys touching routing precedence this week? I remember a change to tenant overrides on Tuesday.

ryan: there was a small PR (infra#1234) that moved tenant-override evaluation to after policy-scopes to simplify caching. That was supposed to be a perf tweak.

priya: oh no — that could mean tenant-specific pool pins are ignored during policy matching and only applied as a fallback. if acme has a tenant override to route gold -> dedicated-gold, we'd miss it.

jenna: confirming alerting: autoscale didn't trigger for their gold pool because traffic was misrouted to shared bronze pool which hit its per-tenant throttle. noisy neighbor behavior then caused 429s.

maria: support customer provided a curl repro. trying locally: 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACME_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-corp" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Tier: gold" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

maria: result we see in our prod proxy: 429 + header `x-redwood-pool: dedicated-bronze` despite X-Redwood-Tier: gold.

dylan: i pulled the control plane decision trace for a sample request (top lines): 
```
TRACE 2026-03-10T08:09:59Z request_id=abc123 tenant=acme-corp headers={"x-redwood-tier":"gold"} policies_evaluated=[global-cost-policy, region-fallback] tenant_override=dedicated-gold applied_after_policies=true final_pool=dedicated-bronze
```

ryan: that `applied_after_policies=true` is the bug. tenant_override should be applied before pool selection so it short-circuits. Looks like infra#1234 changed evaluation order.

priya: can someone reproduce on staging? I can spin a tenant override config: 
```yaml
tenant_overrides:
  acme-corp:
    preferred_pool: dedicated-gold
```
then send requests with X-Redwood-Tier: gold and verify routing.

jenna: i just repro'd on staging — when override is present but evaluated late, request goes to default policy-selected pool. If i revert the evaluation order in-memory, it routes to dedicated-gold as expected.

maria: customer-facing next steps: apologize, explain root cause (routing precedence change), and we will roll back the change for now. Also offer to temporarily increase quota on bronze for their tenant as a bandaid?

ryan: rollback candidate: revert infra#1234 (commit abcdef7). i'll open rollback PR and run canary.

dylan: quick mitigation we can toggle: set feature-flag `tenant-override-early-eval=true` in controlplane config to restore old behavior without full revert. ops-bot: can you apply to prod canary?

ops-bot: action queued: applying feature-flag toggle to prod-canary (region=us-west-2). status=started.

ops-bot: action update: prod-canary toggle applied, routing tests running.

priya: after enabling flag on canary, i ran the curl repro — now header shows `x-redwood-pool: dedicated-gold` and no 429s. good sign.

jenna: i'll coordinate with SRE to progressively roll the toggle to remaining regions after basic smoke.

maria: support reply drafted: 
"We're investigating. Root cause is a recent control plane change that changed tenant override evaluation order; we have a mitigation being rolled out and will follow up with timeline. In the meantime we've applied a temporary config change to route Acme traffic correctly and will offer quota relief if needed."

maria: customer asked for ETA on full fix. Ryan, timeline to revert or safe rollout?

ryan: if canary is green in 10–15m, we can push flag to all regions and monitor. full revert PR will take longer (code + e2e) — estimate 2–3 days to land, test, and ship with release notes.

dylan: adding follow-ups: (1) add unit tests for evaluation ordering, (2) add an integration test that verifies tenant overrides short-circuit policy matching, (3) add alert rule when controlplane decision trace shows applied_after_policies=true for tenant_override.

priya: i'll own tests. ryan: can you own the PR? jenna: can you handle comms and coordinate with Acme?

jenna: will ping Acme support with interim update and offer to lift bronze cap for 2 hours while we finish rollout.

maria: thanks all. please update thread with canary status and timeline.

ops-bot: prod rollout: feature-flag propagated to all regions. smoke-checks passed in us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1.

maria: confirmed with Acme — 429s dropped and they report normal behavior. closing ticket after final postmortem.

ryan: postmortem items logged in internal tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-998 (link).

maria: assigning INF-998 to ryan/priya/dylan/jenna. tagging for postmortem and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

jenna: I'll schedule a short all-hands note to highlight the change and reminder: eval order changes affecting routing must have canary + integration tests.

maria: thread updated. thanks everyone.
